 "rationale": "Sink NMOS mirror with a self-biased (Sooch) wide-swing cascode. Rin*Iin sets the cascode gate so that mirror Vds is about 0.14 V. Long-L mirror pair at high gm/Id gives Vdsat about 0.08 V. Compliance is about Vy+Vdsat4, roughly 0.22 V. Rout is about gm4*ro4*ro2, roughly 50 MΩ against a 7 MΩ need. Both mirror devices see the same Vds, so the static error is under 1%. Iin=Iout=20 µA, 40 µA total."}

PARAMS = {
    "W1":    (40.0, 10.0, 120.0),   # mirror pair width [um] (M1/M2)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),       # mirror pair length [um]
    "W3":    (20.0, 5.0, 80.0),     # cascode pair width [um] (M3/M4)
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),       # cascode pair length [um]
    "Rsc":   (1.0, 0.7, 1.4),       # trim ratio on the computed bias resistor
    "vy":    (0.14, 0.10, 0.20),    # target Vds of mirror devices [V] (sets R)
}

def _solve_vgs(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.05, 1.5
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] > Id:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec["iin"]
    vout = spec["vout_nom"]
    W1, L1, W3, L3, vy = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["W3"], p["L3"], p["vy"]

    # Mirror device M1: Vds = vy (set by cascode), gate at node x
    vgs1 = _solve_vgs(lut, "n", W1, L1, I, vy)
    for _ in range(3):  # Vds3 = vgs1 - vy depends on vgs1 only weakly
        vgs3 = _solve_vgs(lut, "n", W3, L3, I, max(vgs1 - vy, 0.05), vy)
        vgs1 = _solve_vgs(lut, "n", W1, L1, I, vy)
    # Vg_cas = Vx + I*R = Vy + Vgs3  ->  R = (vy + vgs3 - vgs1)/I
    R = max((vy + vgs3 - vgs1) / I, 100.0) * p["Rsc"]

    # Output side: M2 copies M1 bias; M4 cascode at Vds = vout - vy
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vgs1, vy)
    o2 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vgs1, vy)
    o4 = lut.op("n", W3, L3, vgs3, vout - vy, vy)
    ro2 = 1.0 / max(o2["gds"], 1e-15)
    ro4 = 1.0 / max(o4["gds"], 1e-15)
    rout = ro2 + ro4 + o4["gm"] * 1.15 * ro4 * ro2  # 1.15 ~ (gm+gmbs)/gm

    # Error: residual Vds difference across M1/M2 from cascode finite gain
    dvz = (vout - (vgs1 - vy + vy)) / max(o4["gm"] * ro4, 1.0)
    err_pct = 100.0 * abs(o2["gds"] * dvz) / I

    vdsat4 = o4.get("vdsat", 0.08)
    vcomp = vy + min(vdsat4, 0.1)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -> R -> x ; M3 cascode (gate iin) ; M1 diode-ish (gate x)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "x", R)
    n.M("M3", "x", "iin", "y", "vss", "nfet", W3, L3)
    n.M("M1", "y", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    # output branch
    n.M("M4", "iout", "iin", "z", "vss", "nfet", W3, L3)
    n.M("M2", "z", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err_pct,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": vcomp,
        "power": 2 * I * 1.8,
    }
